targeting.why: This one splits. An LCSW does diagnose within scope, and the practice's own published fee list names an initial intake evaluation - so a page here is not a claim of a service that does not exist. What this practice does NOT do is formal psychological or neuropsychological testing, and it does not prescribe, which is what a large share of people typing 'mental health diagnosis near me' actually need.
targeting.how: No new page. /psychologist-vs-therapist-memphis/ already answers exactly this: it sets out which role does psychotherapy, which does formal testing and which prescribes, and it states plainly that Hicks Consulting provides psychotherapy, not testing and not prescriptions. That is the honest answer to the query, and it says no where no is the truth.
targeting.not_this: A page titled for diagnosis or assessment would read as an offer of diagnostic evaluation to someone who may need testing this practice cannot perform.

targeting.why: A trauma center is an emergency medical facility - an ACS-verified Level I to IV hospital unit - or, in the other common reading, a residential or intensive outpatient trauma treatment program. Hicks Consulting is neither. It is a solo licensed clinical social work practice offering virtual psychotherapy to clients located in Tennessee, and its own emergency and crisis notice says in as many words that it does not provide crisis or emergency services. Writing a page for this query would put this practice in front of someone who may be in acute need of a facility it is not, which is the one thing a page must never do in this vertical.
targeting.why_not_a_disambiguation_page: The honest page for this searcher already exists and is already live: /emergency-crisis-notice/ states that no crisis or emergency service is provided and routes to 988, 911 and the nearest emergency room. A second page saying the same thing, optimized to rank for "trauma center", would be competing for the query while disclaiming it - which is worse than not competing, because it wins the click before it explains.
targeting.so_what_happens_instead: The query stays in this file so its impressions keep being measured and this decision keeps being visible. primaryPage points at the crisis notice, which is where a person arriving on this intent should land. No localized variant is created, and no content generator may draft against it: blue_ocean_eligible is false, which is the field content generation reads.
targeting.revisit_if: The practice ever offers, or partners to offer, an actual trauma treatment programme. Nothing short of that changes this.

discovery_gap_pass.why: The observer read a 7-query hand-written list while Search Console reported 46 queries that actually put this practice in front of someone. The measured list is now the target list, ordered so the observer spends its 25-query budget on the queries a client arrives through.

blue_ocean_gate.why: An OPEN occupancy verdict is a statement about WHO the observer cited, not about whether the citations were about this query. Surname-matched queries ("hicks", "carol hicks", "kerry hicks") and queries with no service or location anchor return Hickory PA/NC, Hicksville NY and unrelated practitioners; treating those as open ground is a false blue-ocean signal. Content generation reads blue_ocean_eligible; occupancy.verdict is left untouched.

refused_sources: data/intake/normalized_query_signals.json - 151 RSS titles and subreddit names ("/r/BlackWomens", "reddit.com: search results - ..."). Topic signals, not queries anyone searched. The normalizer tags every one status "candidate" for exactly this reason.
any modelled or estimated search volume - no live paid keyword source exists on this account.

quarantined_awaiting_targeting_decision.why: A query that implies a place and names none cannot be answered as typed. These arrived from a Search Console refresh nobody reviewed, so they are measured but not admitted: blue_ocean_eligible is false and no generator may draft against them until a localized variant or a recorded non-target decision exists.
quarantined_awaiting_targeting_decision.enforced_by: scripts/lib/demand_titles.js#blueOceanEligibility (AWAITING_TARGETING_DECISION) and _ops/validators/validate_discovery_gap.js, which hard-fails once decide_by passes.

lead_intent_classifier.T1_LOCAL_READY: near me / open now / in <City ST> / in-network / takes insurance / accepting new clients
lead_intent_classifier.T2_COST_IN_MARKET: how much / cost / price / fee / sliding scale / does insurance cover / out of pocket
lead_intent_classifier.T3_SELECTION: how to choose|compare|find / red flags / vs / comparison / which is better / what to ask / best
lead_intent_classifier.T4_INFORMATIONAL: everything else - definitions, lists, process explanations
lead_intent_classifier.note: Word-boundary anchored. `\bfees?\b` deliberately does not match "feel", which matters here: "i feel" phrasing is everywhere in this vertical.

openness_method.input: citations from data/search/query_observations.json, produced by scripts/search/live_query_observer.mjs (OpenRouter web plugin, engine=parallel, mode=turbo)
openness_method.platform_share: share of distinct cited hosts that are directories, marketplaces or user-generated platforms
openness_method.institutional_share: share of distinct cited hosts on .gov/.edu/.mil or wikipedia
openness_method.geo_precondition: A query that implies a location ("near me", "nearby", "open now") but names none is not answerable, so its citations are geographic noise and its openness reading is meaningless. Those are scored UNRESOLVABLE_WITHOUT_LOCATION and carry no openness_score. Measure the localized variant instead.

verdicts.HELD_BY_US: the search already surfaced this practice - not an opportunity, a position to defend
verdicts.OPEN: openness_score >= 0.6 - the answer is assembled from directories and platforms and no page owns it
verdicts.HELD: openness_score < 0.4 - institutions or established publishers occupy the answer
verdicts.UNMEASURED: the observer has not answered for this query; NOT a zero and never to be read as one
verdicts.UNRESOLVABLE_WITHOUT_LOCATION: the query implies a place and names none, so no incumbent can hold it and "not cited" is an artifact of the question, NOT open ground

openness_method.not_measured: search volume, keyword difficulty, organic rank. The observer says so itself: rankVerified is false on every observation.
